reuse.sustained_load semantics copied (not imp: payload, x-benchmark-request-id request header, x-request-id response header, 503 admission body signature, data: line handling, [DONE]

backend_argv --served-model-name values (space form, exactly one occurrence) != served_model_names

sse_parse.event: json.loads; telemetry.has_sse_content(event) ValueError -> error_event if event.error not null else invalid
sse_parse.choice: index (default 0) must be 0; finish_reason must be str|null

finish_reason_evidence.observed: exactly one distinct non-null value and no content after it
finish_reason_evidence.contradiction: two distinct values or content after a finish_reason

sse_parse.usage: exactly one non-null usage object -> completion_tokens if int>=0; none -> absent; >1 -> multiple (null); bad -> invalid (null)

fates.not_launched: never reached POST (incl. cancelled before send)
fates.rejected: HTTP 503 with JSON dict detail=='request rejected: admission capacity exceeded' and estimated_request_cost key
fates.complete: 2xx, [DONE], content, no anomaly (finish_reason may be absent -> natural SLO not good)
fates.cancelled: in flight at the drain deadline (offered_end + drain_timeout) or replay interruption after send

row_mapping.sent_at: monotonic immediately before client.stream (send attempt start; null if never sent)
row_mapping.terminal_at: monotonic in finally after the response context closed (consume_request finished_at semantics; null if never sent)

schedule: offered_start = driver-given absolute monotonic (refused if already past) or now+start_delay; each request task sleeps until offered_start+arrival (loop until monotonic >= target, never early), then sends; no rescheduling, compression, drop or cherry-pick; connection pool = offered count; after offered_end wait until offered_end+drain_timeout then cancel remaining

capture_status.refused: binding/prerequisite refusal before any request (no offered window)
capture_status.failed: internal error: rows retained when available

run_builder.envelope: offered_cohort_observed: [offered_start, max(offered_end, terminals)]; full_wall only from a driver record {start,end,clock_domain,source} with start<=offered_start, end>=max(collection_end, terminals), same clock_domain
run_builder.static_fixed control: driver control {kind,budget,basis} + control_evidence {acknowledged_at < offered_start, clock_domain, source}
run_builder.non-fixed: driver measured_intervals control or control_missing reason

not_client_owned: final gateway drain and fallback counters
